name: Infinite Layers Grid
description: Full-screen endlessly tiling image grid with captions, dragged or wheel-scrolled in any direction, with mouse parallax, press zoom and an animated intro.
contents: Scattered image tiles with multi-line captions that repeat infinitely in both axes
behavior: Wheel and drag (mouse or touch) pan the grid in all directions with eased smoothing
Mouse position shifts tiles and images for parallax, pressing zooms images
Tiles fly in from the center with a staggered intro on mount
Caption lines slide up when tiles enter the viewport
editableByProps: Images, caption lines and tile layout
Background and text colors, font family and caption size
Scroll smoothing, wheel speed, parallax, zoom and intro timing

needsCodeEdit.where: The style block with the line-mask and line transitions

needsCodeEdit.change: Change how many times tiles repeat
needsCodeEdit.where: repsX and repsY arrays in the build function

fixed: Takes over page wheel scrolling with preventDefault while mounted, listeners removed on unmount
Loads the Roboto Mono stylesheet from Google Fonts
Root is a full-viewport 100vh section, grid is rebuilt on window resize
Tile positions scale with window width
